_comment: DCA dip-buy target ladder + per-alert tranche sizing. Kept in sync with TradingView alerts. direction 'below' = trigger when price <= target. buyNow = tranche to buy when the alert first fires; buyDeeper = second tranche on a further ~3-4% dip (averaging-in). yahooSymbol fetches the live price for the daily distance-to-trigger readout. Edit levels/sizes here → they update in the next briefing. Sizing per Ledger 2026-08-05 against live cash (CASH_USD $19,517 + CASH_THB ~$17,264).

budget.note: Deploy caps this round (~half of liquid cash; buffer covers living costs, tuition scholarship-covered). Keep a running tally as alerts fill. If the USD cap exhausts before all fire, priority order: VOO > VEA > SMH > LLY > UBER > GLDM (core diversification first; UBER tactical + gold near-cap cut first).
